description: CBRE Group, Inc. is the world's largest commercial real estate services and investments firm based on 2025 revenue, deriving competitive advantage from its considerable scale and ability to offer integrated solutions for real estate investors and occupiers in more than 100 countries. It is a global market leader in most of its business lines and drives significant growth by helping clients optimize real estate costs, value, investment returns and workplace experiences, with those capabilities combined with an extensive knowledge platform of research, data and strategy that generated superior outcomes for clients including nearly 90 percent of Fortune 100 companies and many of the world's largest institutional real estate investors in 2025. Its strategy achieves growth across four dimensions of its business, geographies, clients, property types and services, and its Project Management segment delivers program management, project management and cost consultancy services globally through Turner & Townsend, in which it now owns 70 percent of the combined entity.
